1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line height, though letter spacing is standard rather than notably generous.

2.why: The guidance sentences contain no italics or dense paragraphs, and the only all-caps text is the small 'STEP 1 OF 5' label rather than the instructions themselves.

3.why: The single-column, mobile-width layout with full-width fields and button reads clearly, aside from an unexplained empty dark 'Logs' panel.

4.why: Every instruction is a brief plain-language sentence, such as 'Confirm your bank account details to protect higher-value payments.'

5.why: The placeholder values 'marcus@example.test' and '+15551234567', reinforced by the note 'use the displayed example details', show exactly what the expected input should look like.

6.why: No screen contains more than a two-line sentence, so the user is never required to read a long block of text to proceed.

7.why: The observed screens never display an authenticator secret or recovery codes and offer no copy affordance, so long codes cannot be copied.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears on any of the four screenshots, which never advance past the sign-in step.

9.why: The email and phone fields are ordinary text inputs with no visible autocomplete hooks, and no password or OTP field exists to demonstrate password-manager support.

10.why: The 'STEP 1 OF 5' eyebrow and the single prominent blue 'Continue securely' button make the current step and primary action stand out clearly.

11.why: Each screen presents exactly one main action, the 'Continue securely' button.

12.why: After submission the only feedback is the banner 'Unable to sign in with those details.', which never states what happens next, and the flow never advances beyond step 1.

13.why: The form remains editable so a sign-in attempt can be retried without visible penalty, but no reveal, hide, or re-request controls exist because codes are never issued.

14.why: The error 'Unable to sign in with those details.' is non-blaming but states neither the cause nor how to fix it, even when the displayed example details are used.

15.why: No countdown or reading time limit appears on any screen, but because enrolment never reaches code entry the generosity of code-entry time cannot be observed.
